lastResponse.text: You did the right thing calling. Let’s get you somewhere safe today. If you’re in immediate danger right now, call nine one one first. A good same-day option is Right Track Resource Center, at 501 third Street, La Grande. They’re drop-in and don’t require documents. Call: five four one, nine six two, seven nine nine four. Backup: five four one, nine one zero, three zero five six. If you want, I can stay with you while you call.
originalTexts: You did the right thing calling. Let’s get you somewhere safe today. If you’re in immediate danger right now, call 911 first. A good same-day option is **Right Track Resource Center**, at **501 3rd Street, La Grande**. They’re drop-in and don’t require documents. Call: **541-962-7994**. Backup: **541-910-3056**. If you want, I can stay with you while you call.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: Hi, sorry, I’m kind of freaking out right now. I need somewhere I can go today, like a youth day center, I can’t stay where I am.
